claims.summary: The telemetry subscriber has persistent connection, retry, integration, and persistence boundaries whose timing can diverge from connection health.
claims.disposition: Verify current subscriber and telemetry integration source.

claims.summary: Lock contention or heavy prewrite work could delay mechanical persistence even while WebSocket receipt remains healthy.
claims.disposition: Use the existing separated prewrite, write-lock-wait, and write-lock-hold evidence and observational study classifications; do not infer felt causation.

claims.summary: Changing database, lock, retry, or buffering behavior would alter the live telemetry persistence path.
claims.disposition: Preserve current behavior; require a separately grounded and tested live-path change before any such mutation.
